scope: Bounded asynchronous live inputs across Kafka partitions, Flink and PostgreSQL; finite local load test
latency_definition: First PostgreSQL assessment insert timestamp minus producer_time, including event-time waiting, checkpoint commits and any database outage; requires synchronized clocks

steady_load.scope: Offered payments to durable assessments; excludes warmup and post-publication drain
steady_load.reason: The driver did not maintain its offered schedule; this run cannot qualify the requested processing rate

reconciliation.scope: Acknowledged inputs in this run; control records require archiving only

metrics_summary.scope: Entire command, including startup and final drain; not a steady-state saturation test

load_metrics_summary.scope: Publishing after warmup; not a steady-state saturation test

supplemental_observations.comparison_limits: One trial per parallelism on a shared host, sequential runs with retained data. Risk processor and database writer/schema source hashes match. Between trials, auxiliary late-input routing and benchmark reporting changed; regular live-payment routing is identical.
